displayName: MultiFocus - Multiple Cursors & Focus Manager for NVDA
description:
MultiFocus gives NVDA users multiple independent cursors
and virtual focuses across applications, web pages, and documents.
Create multiple focus markers, cycle between them, toggle between
recent locations, or peek at other cursor positions without losing
your active work.
changelog:
Initial release of MultiFocus featuring multiple cursors,
quick toggle, interactive cursor manager dialog, audio peeking,
and automatic window switching.
